subject: general
question: On 28 October 2024, in which city of Gujarat did Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Spanish PM Pedro Sanchez inaugurate the Tata Aircraft Complex, India’s first private facility to build military planes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vadodara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• On 28 October 2024, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Spanish PM Pedro Sanchez jointly inaugurated the Tata Aircraft Complex in Vadodara, Gujarat.
 
• The Tata Aircraft Complex is India's first private facility dedicated to the construction of military aircraft.
 
• This facility is expected to enhance India's self-reliance in the defense sector by manufacturing key military planes domestically.
 
• Vadodara was chosen due to its strategic location and existing infrastructure supporting the aerospace industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Make in India:**

 
 
• Launched by PM Narendra Modi in 2014, it is an initiative to encourage companies to manufacture their products in India.
 
• It aims to increase the GDP growth and tax revenue by producing quality products domestically.
 
 
 
• **Defense Industrial Corridors:**
 
 
• India has established two defense industrial corridors, one in Uttar Pradesh and another in Tamil Nadu.
 
• These corridors aim to develop a robust defense manufacturing ecosystem in the country.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Partnership Model:**
 
 
• This model encourages Indian private firms to collaborate with foreign original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).
 
• It aims to boost indigenous production of defense equipment.
 
 
 
• **Aerospace and Defense Policies:**
 
 
• Several state governments have introduced policies to attract investments in the aerospace and defense sectors.
 
• These policies offer incentives like subsidies, tax rebates, and infrastructural support to manufacturers.
